selection: Highest equally weighted real/stress chip mean among five new configurations; control is diagnostic. Freeze before confirmation.

confirmation.additional_regression_opponents: All remaining jish versions, previous structured size/bluff opponents, and three new adversarial opponents

runtime: Official HTTP fresh-half tests against complete confirmation field; Python 3.12 Linux wheel availability checked; attempt official constrained Docker smoke check through free GitHub Actions on public repository.
promotion: Require positive 95% seed-block t intervals for balanced chip and point gains, nonnegative real/stress means, no material opponent regression (upper interval below -0.25 bb/deal), no clear direct loss to jish_4/jish_7/jish_8/jish_9, no runtime failures, and container check success. Otherwise publish experimental and retain jish_4.
scope: No claim to find every possible weakness or solve poker; audit known strategy/runtime risks, preserve old versions and document remaining limitations.
